html:
Here are two images taken Sunday evening with the Soligor 135mm F 2.8 lens

The Pleiades (M45)

F2.8, ISO 200, 30 second exposures. Stack of 7 images with 24 dark frames, no flat frame.
Stacking in Nebulosity, processing in Photoshop.




The Leo Triplet (M65, M66 and NGC3628)

F2.8, ISO 200, 60 second exposures. Stack of 26 images with 9 dark frames, no flat frame.
Stacking in Nebulosity, processing in Photoshop.



The stars aren't round and show a lot of "flare".
I'll do new tests at F4.0 and ISO 800 and try to focus a bit better.
